newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 31.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 31.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones rose 83.12 points to 6,823.86. PLDT's ADR gained $0 5/8 to $60 1/8.
* The peso closed weaker at 26.346 to a U.S. dollar from 26.343.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index jumped 19.15 points to end at a record closing high of 3,392.76.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was steady at 10.53125 percent.

* Manila Electric Co (Meralco) says electricity rates for its industrial and large commercial customers will be 4.5 centavos per kilowatt-hour (kwh) as it will be passing on to consumeres the savings derived from its improved operations. (MANILA BULLETIN)

* Ayala Corp and Benpres Holdings will have to shoulder some seven billion pesos of outstanding foreign debt of the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System (MWSS). Ayala and Benpres were the winners in the privatisation of the country's largest water utility. (BUSINESSWORLD)
* Solid Bank Corp says its net income in the three months ending December 31 was 156.88 million pesos. (BUSINESSWORLD)
* Petron Corp posts net income of 4.238 billion pesos in 1996, up by 5.4 percent from last year's 4.020 billion pesos (CHRONICLE)
* Jollibee Foods Corp says its unaudited net income for 1996 reach 603 million pesos, 12 percent higher than 537 million pesos the previous year. (PHILIPPINE STAR)
* Vitarich Corp, one of the country's biggest poultry producers, posts lower losses in the fourth quarter of 1996 to 367 million pesos from 571 million pesos in the third quarter. (BUSINESS DAILY)
